card.name: Nin-ety and digits inside DOI numbers
card.fires_on: The piece "ety" in "Ninety" at the start of a sentence, and a single digit (8 or 9) in the middle of a DOI or catalogue number.

modes.label: Ninety at sentence start
modes.description: The ending "ety" of "Ninety" opening a sentence, usually before a hyphenated number or "percent".

modes.label: Digit inside a DOI or ID
modes.description: A single digit 8 or 9 partway through a long numeric reference code such as a DOI or galaxy number.

card.writes: Promoted and suppressed tokens are a mixed bag of unrelated pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the end of the word "Ninety" and on a digit inside long reference numbers like DOIs.
